attempts.text:
{
  "map": true,
  "subject": {"columns": ["protein_id"], "resolver": "pharos_protein_gene", "category": "biolink:Gene"},
  "object": {"columns": ["mondoid", "did"], "resolver": "curie", "category": "biolink:Disease", "name_column": "ncats_name"},
  "predicate": "biolink:correlated_with",
  "association_category": "biolink:Association",
  "knowledge_level": "statistical_association",
  "agent_type": "data_analysis_pipeline",
  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:expression-atlas",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["log2foldchange", "pvalue"],
  "keep_if": null,
  "split_by": null,
  "notes": "Each row is a differential expression result for a gene in a disease versus a control, from Expression Atlas, processed by IDG-KMC. It is a statistical association, so I used correlated_with rather than a causal or expression predicate. log2foldchange and pvalue stay on the edge as properties. pvalue is stored as a string, so I did not filter on it. The mondoid column is filled on every row; did (DOID) is the fallback."
}
